utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — we’re still aiming for the repair drive soon, and I’ll keep it low-key. Once the start time’s set, I’ll repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Vik — once you’ve got the start time, send it my way and I’ll help wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, I can borrow the tools if I need them for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, absolutely — if you need the tools for the repair drive, you can borrow them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — yes, please spread the word, and if you can swing by with the details, that’d be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll swing by with the repair drive details and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the running list of what we need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep you posted on the start time once I know it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, nice — it sounds like the repair drive is really coming together. I’ll pass along whatever I hear about what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you confirm the exact spot and start time for the repair drive? I can jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the exact spot and start time first, then I’ll let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you start with the repair drive details? Just the first item is enough, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you confirm the exact start time and meeting spot for the repair drive? I’m happy to bring whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m keeping an eye out for the exact spot and I’ll let you know as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll do the same and keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Sam. Leo and I are still sorting the logistics, so I’ll let you know what needs doing as soon as we’ve got it set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still watching for the exact spot they set up the repair drive, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know what we need and swing by with the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Quinn — just bring me the details when you have them, and I’ll see what I can lend you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What time does the repair drive start, and should I bring gloves or tape?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still checking the exact spot, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. If you can, bring gloves and some tape just in case.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing bits second-hand, but it sounds like the repair drive is coming up soon and staying pretty low-key. What’s the latest you’ve heard?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s been gathered so far for the repair drive, and can you let me know the start time when you have it?
